column1: @ SELECT n.value, c.etag, c.repo_etag, c.checked_at, c.next_check_at, c.fail_count, c.app_installed FROM repo_checks c JOIN names n ON n.id = c.repo ORDER BY n.value
@ SELECT r.log_index, n.value, r.tag, r.withdrawn, r.withdrawn_at FROM releases r JOIN names n ON n.id = r.repo ORDER BY r.log_index
